title: Queue Steward Dashboard
description: Agent queue monitoring dashboard for SigNoz observability using ClickHouse log analytics

widgets.title: Queue Depth Overview
widgets.description: Latest queue depth reported by the queue steward telemetry

clickhouse_sql.name: Queue Depth
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT JSONExtractInt(body, 'queueLength') AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE body LIKE '%"dataset":"agent_queue"%' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

widgets.title: Ready vs Pending Jobs
widgets.description: Ready and pending job counts over time

clickhouse_sql.name: Ready
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS timestamp, avg(JSONExtractInt(body, 'readyCount')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE body LIKE '%"dataset":"agent_queue"%' AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp) >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY timestamp ORDER BY timestamp

clickhouse_sql.name: Pending
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS timestamp, avg(JSONExtractInt(body, 'pendingCount')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE body LIKE '%"dataset":"agent_queue"%' AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp) >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY timestamp ORDER BY timestamp

clickhouse_sql.name: Kill Switch
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toInt32(JSONExtractBool(body, 'killSwitch')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE body LIKE '%"dataset":"agent_queue"%' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

widgets.title: Per-Lane Performance
widgets.description: Snapshot of lane readiness and pending counts

clickhouse_sql.name: Lanes
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(body, 'lanes', 'type') AS lane, JSONExtractInt(body, 'lanes', 'ready') AS ready, JSONExtractInt(body, 'lanes', 'pending') AS pending, JSONExtractFloat(body, 'lanes', 'avgPriority') AS avg_priority, JSONExtractInt(body, 'lanes', 'prioritySum') AS priority_sum, JSONExtractInt(body, 'lanes', 'total') AS total, JSONExtractString(body, 'timestamp') AS reported_at FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE body LIKE '%"dataset":"agent_queue"%' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Queue Depth Trend (24h)
widgets.description: Queue length trend over the last 24 hours

clickhouse_sql.name: Queue Depth
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS timestamp, avg(JSONExtractInt(body, 'queueLength')) AS value FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE body LIKE '%"dataset":"agent_queue"%' AND fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp) >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY timestamp ORDER BY timestamp

widgets.title: Agent Health
widgets.description: Latest agent metadata and processed jobs

clickhouse_sql.name: Agent
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(body, 'agentName') AS agent_name, JSONExtractInt(body, 'jobsProcessed') AS jobs_processed, JSONExtractString(body, 'lastRun') AS last_run, JSONExtractString(body, 'timestamp') AS reported_at FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE body LIKE '%"dataset":"agent_queue"%' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 5
